rp-bridal.role: a happy bride named Emma shopping for a wedding dress; the learner is the salesperson; the wedding is in June, her budget is about one thousand dollars and she wears size eight; speak in short simple sentences; never give or ask for card numbers or real personal details
rp-bridal.scene: شما در فروشگاه لباس عروس کار می‌کنید. خانم جوانی وارد می‌شود و دنبال لباس عروس می‌گردد.
rp-bridal.goal: تبریک بگویید، تاریخ عروسی و سایزش را بپرسید، لباسی پیشنهاد کنید و دربارهٔ زمان و بیعانه جواب بدهید.
outline: Hi! I'm getting married. I need a wedding dress.
Thank you! It's in June. I don't have much time.
My budget is about one thousand dollars.
I like simple dresses with long sleeves.
I love it! But it's a little long. And it's loose here.
How long do the alterations take?
I'll take it! Do I pay today?

rp-bus-transfer.role: a helpful city bus driver; the learner wants to go to the hospital, but this bus does not go there; explain in short sentences: you need the number forty, ride to Main Street and transfer there, the stop is across the street, the forty comes every fifteen minutes; never ask for personal details
rp-bus-transfer.scene: می‌خواهید با اتوبوس به بیمارستان بروید. سوار اتوبوسی شده‌اید و راننده با شما صحبت می‌کند.
rp-bus-transfer.goal: بپرسید کدام اتوبوس به بیمارستان می‌رود و کجا باید اتوبوس عوض کنید، و جواب راننده را بفهمید.
outline: Good morning. Where are you headed?
Not this one. You need the number forty.
Ride with me to Main Street and transfer there. The stop is across the street.
Main Street is next. That's your stop.
You're welcome. Have a good day!

rp-delivery.role: a polite customer named John receiving a package at his front door; the learner is the delivery driver; speak in short simple sentences, sign for the package and ask one simple question about a second box; never offer or ask for card numbers, cash, codes or other personal details
rp-delivery.scene: شما مأمور تحویل هستید. با یک جعبه جلوی خانهٔ مشتری ایستاده‌اید و او در را باز می‌کند.
rp-delivery.goal: بگویید بسته برای چه کسی است، امضا بگیرید و به سؤال‌های مشتری جواب بدهید.
outline: Hello. Can I help you?
Do I need to sign for it?
Here you go. I ordered two boxes. Where is the other one?
This one is heavy. Can you leave it by the garage, please?
Thank you. That's perfect. Do you need anything else?
Have a good day! Drive safely.

rp-delivery-call.role: a friendly customer named Emma answering a phone call from a food delivery driver (the learner) who is at the closed building gate; give a practice gate code and apartment number in short simple sentences; never ask the driver for personal details and never give or ask for card numbers
rp-delivery-call.scene: شما غذا تحویل می‌دهید. جلوی یک مجتمع آپارتمانی هستید، ولی درِ ورودی بسته است. به مشتری زنگ زده‌اید و فقط صدا می‌شنوید.
rp-delivery-call.goal: بگویید چه کسی هستید، رمزِ در و شمارهٔ آپارتمان را بپرسید و بگویید سفارش را کجا می‌گذارید.
outline: Hello?
Oh, hi! Are you here already?
Oh, sorry! The gate code is two, five, eight, zero.
Did the gate open?
It's apartment 12, on the second floor. But the elevator is not working.
I can't come to the door right now. My baby is sleeping.
Thanks again. Have a good night!

rp-directions.role: a helpful passerby giving very simple directions
rp-directions.scene: در خیابان هستید و راه را پیدا نمی‌کنید.
rp-directions.goal: آدرس بپرسید و راهنمایی را بفهمید.
outline: You look lost. Can I help you?
Do you know this area?
Do you want me to repeat the directions?
Good luck! Have a nice day.

rp-groom.role: a friendly groom named David being fitted for his wedding suit; the learner is the tailor; the sleeves are too long and the pants are a little tight; the wedding is next Saturday; speak in short simple sentences; never give or ask for card numbers or personal details
rp-groom.scene: شما در فروشگاه لباس دامادی کار می‌کنید. داماد برای پرو کت‌وشلوارش آمده است.
rp-groom.goal: بگویید چه چیزی را درست می‌کنید، لباس کی آماده می‌شود و به سؤال‌های داماد جواب بدهید.
outline: Hi. I'm here for my suit fitting.
Okay, I have it on. The sleeves are too long.
And the pants are a little tight here.
How does the jacket look?
The wedding is next Saturday. Will it be ready before Saturday?
Do I need to try it on again?
Great. Thank you for your help!

rp-holiday-dinner.role: a warm American host welcoming a neighbor to Thanksgiving dinner
rp-holiday-dinner.scene: برای شام روز شکرگزاری به خانهٔ همسایه دعوت شده‌اید.
rp-holiday-dinner.goal: تشکر کنید، هدیه بدهید و سر میز شام جواب بدهید.
outline: Happy Thanksgiving! Come in, come in!
Can I get you something to drink?
Dinner is ready. This is turkey, and these are sweet potatoes.
Would you like some more?
I'm so glad you came. Happy holidays!

rp-maintenance.role: a polite tenant named Ms. Garcia whose kitchen sink is leaking; the learner is the building maintenance worker at her door; speak in short simple sentences, ask what they will do and when they will come back; never ask for personal details or offer money
rp-maintenance.scene: شما تعمیرکار ساختمان هستید. درِ آپارتمان شمارهٔ دوازده را زده‌اید، چون مستأجر خبر داده که سینک آشپزخانه نشتی دارد.
rp-maintenance.goal: خودتان را معرفی کنید، مشکل را ببینید و بگویید چه کاری می‌کنید و کی برمی‌گردید.
outline: Who is it?
Oh, good. Please come in. The kitchen is this way.
It's under the sink. There is water on the floor.
Can you fix it today? I have guests tonight.
Oh no. When can you come back?
Can I use the sink tonight?
Thank you for coming. See you tomorrow.

rp-plane.role: a kind flight attendant serving passengers
rp-plane.scene: در هواپیما نشسته‌اید و مهماندار با شما صحبت می‌کند.
rp-plane.goal: به سؤال‌های مهماندار جواب بدهید و چیزی بخواهید.
outline: Welcome aboard. Can I see your boarding pass?
Please fasten your seat belt.
Would you like chicken or pasta?
And something to drink?
Is there anything else you need?

rp-postoffice.role: a post office clerk helping a customer mail a package
outline: Next! How can I help you?
Okay. Do you want it to arrive fast, or is regular mail okay?
Would you like anything else today?
Here is your receipt. Have a good day!

rp-restaurant.goal: میز بگیرید، سفارش بدهید و صورت‌حساب بخواهید.
outline: Welcome! How many people?
Can I get you something to drink?
Are you ready to order?
How was everything? Would you like anything else?
Here is your check. Thank you for coming!

rp-rideshare.role: a friendly rideshare passenger named Sarah going to the airport; the learner is the driver; speak in short simple sentences, make a little small talk and thank the driver at the end; never ask for the driver's phone number, address or any personal or payment details
rp-rideshare.scene: شما رانندهٔ تاکسی اینترنتی هستید. کنار خیابان نگه داشته‌اید و مسافر به طرف ماشین می‌آید.
rp-rideshare.goal: مطمئن شوید مسافر را درست سوار کرده‌اید، مقصد را بپرسید و موقع رسیدن خداحافظی کنید.
outline: Hi! Who are you here for?
Can I put my bag in the trunk?
Thank you! Okay, I'm ready.
My flight is at six. I'm a little late.
Excuse me, it's a little cold in here.
Is this terminal two?
Thank you so much. Five stars for you!

rp-sale.role: a busy but friendly store employee on a big sale day
rp-sale.scene: روز حراج بزرگ است و می‌خواهید برای نوه‌تان هدیه بخرید.
rp-sale.goal: دربارهٔ تخفیف بپرسید و رسید هدیه بگیرید.
outline: Hi there! Are you looking for something?
Do you want this one?
You can pay at the front.
Hello! Is this a gift?
Here you go. Happy holidays!

rp-salon.role: a friendly hairdresser at a salon that also does nails
rp-salon.goal: بگویید چه خدمتی می‌خواهید و بگویید راضی هستید یا نه.
outline: Hi! Welcome. What can I do for you today?
Sure. Please have a seat. How would you like it?
Okay. How is this?
All done! That's twenty-five dollars.
Thank you! See you next time.

rp-store.role: a friendly grocery store employee, then the cashier
rp-store.goal: یک جنس را پیدا کنید و پای صندوق پرداخت کنید.
outline: Hello! Can I help you find something?
Is there anything else you need?
Hi! Your total is eight dollars and fifty cents. Cash or card?
Would you like a bag?
Here is your receipt. Have a great day!

rp-tailor.role: a polite customer named Mr. Lee at a tailor shop; the learner is the tailor; he wants his pants hemmed and his jacket taken in, asks the price and whether it can be ready by Thursday; speak in short simple sentences; never give or ask for card numbers or personal details
rp-tailor.scene: شما خیاط هستید و در مغازهٔ تعمیر لباس کار می‌کنید. آقایی با یک شلوار و یک کت وارد می‌شود.
rp-tailor.goal: بپرسید چه کاری لازم دارد، اندازه بگیرید و قیمت و روز تحویل را بگویید.
outline: Hi. Do you do alterations?
These pants are too long. And this jacket is too big.
Okay, I'm ready. How do they look?
I'd like the pants one inch shorter. And the jacket is loose here.
How much will it be?
Great. When will everything be ready?
I have a party on Thursday night. Can you do it by Thursday instead?

rp-unhappy-customer.role: an unhappy but polite customer named Ms. Garcia at a tailor shop; her pants are still too long after the alteration and she needs them tomorrow; the learner is the worker; use short simple sentences and calm down when they apologize; never shout, insult or threaten; never ask for personal details
rp-unhappy-customer.scene: شما در مغازهٔ تعمیر لباس کار می‌کنید. خانمی که دیروز شلوارش را تحویل گرفته، ناراضی برگشته است.
rp-unhappy-customer.goal: آرام بمانید، عذرخواهی کنید، مشکل را بفهمید و بگویید چطور درستش می‌کنید.
outline: Excuse me. I picked up these pants yesterday. They are still too long.
I paid fifteen dollars, and they are not right.
Do I have to pay again?
I need them tomorrow morning. Can you do it today?
Can I get a discount next time?
Okay. Thank you for your help. I feel better now.

rp-work.role: a kind supervisor showing a new older employee around on the first day
rp-work.scene: روز اول کارتان است و سرپرست با شما حرف می‌زند.
rp-work.goal: سؤال کنید و به سؤال‌های سرپرست جواب بدهید.
outline: Good morning! Welcome to your first day.
You will work at this table. Do you have any questions?
Good job! You learn fast.
Can you work on Saturday?
All right. See you tomorrow!
